description: Search the RateCard Health index of healthcare B2B trade publications, association e-newsletters and journals that publish advertising rate cards. Filter by category (e.g. dental, pharmacy, nursing, health IT), format (e-newsletter, print, dedicated email) and/or a free-text query (name, publisher, audience). Returns name, publisher, category, format, stated circulation/open rate, entry ad price BAND (exact only for the 10 free-sample rows) and the public page URL.

category.description: Category name or slug: clinical-laboratory, dental, health-it, hospital-operations-administration, nursing, pharmacy, physicians-medical-practice, public-health

query.description: Free text matched against publication name, publisher, audience and sub-vertical
